niche_preference_profile: Prefers interfaces with strong visual hierarchy, clear section grouping, and polished contemporary styling. They consistently respond well to layouts that feel intentional and well-structured, with readable progression, distinct modules, and obvious actions. They often like airy spacing and simplified presentation, but in some contexts also prefer denser, more content-rich screens when that improves clarity, action visibility, and hierarchy. They generally favor refined, modern aesthetics over generic utilitarian ones, with restrained but deliberate use of contrast, accent color, and component styling.

criteria.description: Prefers clear, prominent hierarchy with a strong title/headline, obvious section progression, and distinct separation between primary and secondary content.
Prefers content organized into clearly grouped sections, cards, rows, or labeled modules rather than fragmented or weakly structured layouts.
Prefers interfaces that feel contemporary, polished, editorial, premium, or mature rather than generic, mechanical, enterprise-like, or system-default.
Prefers fewer competing elements, restrained decoration, cleaner chrome, and more focused presentation over cluttered or overly procedural screens.
Prefers interfaces where the main action is obvious and controls feel purposeful, with clear CTA emphasis and visible interaction choices.
Prefers components with intentional container treatment—well-defined cards, rows, panels, or layered surfaces that create readable separation and compositional coherence.
Prefers layouts with enough spacing, margin, and visual rhythm to make content easier to scan and feel less cramped, when this does not reduce clarity or completeness.
